message: Last winter, we had a surprise snowstorm that everyone seemed to forget about until it was too late. I had just filled up the pantry with snacks—mostly for the grandkids, of course. When the snow started piling up, I realized that our little stash of goodies kept spirits high and hunger at bay during a cozy weekend indoors. A small win, but it sure did save the day! What’s your go-to comfort food for unexpected weather? 🍪
